Resume a job that needs attention

Usage:
  kaab jobs resume JOB_ID (--apply PRP_ID [--promote] [--remember site] | --skip-step | --retry-from-checkpoint | --continue | --abort) [flags]

Flags:
      --abort                   abort the job
      --apply string            apply this proposal (prp_…)
      --continue                continue after a takeover
  -h, --help                    help for resume
      --promote                 with --apply: publish the change as a new version
      --remember string         with --apply: none or site
      --retry-from-checkpoint   run again from the last checkpoint
      --skip-step               skip the step that stopped

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
